answer_2.quote: We use various automatic evaluation metrics. The success rate ... is the core metric measuring the success of the attacking method. ... the perturbed percentage is also crucial ... Under the black‑box setting, queries of the target model ... We also use Universal Sentence Encoder to measure the semantic consistency between the adversarial sample and the original sequence.

answer_4.quote: We set up human evaluations to measure the quality of the generated samples in fluency and grammar as well as semantic preservation. We ask human judges to score the grammar correctness of the mixed sentences ... scoring from 1‑5. Then we ask human judges to make predictions in a shuffled mix of original and adversarial texts.
answer_4.guideline: Human judges score grammar correctness (1‑5) and predict the correct label for each sentence; semantic preservation is also assessed.
